SUMMARY.md: API key for authentication. Get your key at https://kiprio.com/vat-api/

This API enables real-time validation of EU VAT numbers using the official VIES service. It provides not only the validity of the VAT number but also the associated company's name and address in a single JSON response. Supports all 27 EU member states plus Northern Ireland (XI).
